Unde staționare într-o coardă elastică: Standing waves on an elastic string
Reflexia impulsului la capătul corzii: Pulse reflection at the end of a string
Capătul stâng este fix. Nodurile au elon: The left end is fixed. Nodes always have zero displacement, and antinodes have amplitude 2A.
Sunt afișate cele două componente de pro: Both travelling components and their sum are shown. A fixed end inverts the pulse; a free end reflects it without inversion.
Diagrama corzii; derulare orizontală pe: String diagram; scroll horizontally on a phone
A este amplitudinea fiecărei unde progre: A is the amplitude of each travelling wave; the resultant amplitude is 2A|sin(2πx/λ)|. The harmonic standing wave is already established.
La prima întâlnire cu capătul drept, com: At the first encounter with the right end, the right-moving component is incident and the left-moving component is reflected. After later reflections, colours continue to identify propagation direction. A reflected pulse is not a standing wave.
Animație încetinită: fundamentala se ved: Slowed animation: the fundamental is displayed at 0.2 Hz. Readouts show physical frequency and time.
Animație încetinită: o traversare L/v_f: Slowed animation: one L/v_f crossing takes 1.5 s on screen. The slider covers four crossings; the displayed time is physical time.
Schimbarea parametrilor reîncepe experim: Changing parameters restarts the experiment paused. Model: an ideal uniform, perfectly elastic string, with small transverse oscillations and no losses.
Capătul liber alunecă vertical pe un ghi: The free end slides vertically on a frictionless guide; transverse force is zero. During the first reflection, endpoint displacement can reach 2A.
Elongațiile sunt amplificate vizual; axe: Displacements are visually magnified; the axes use different scales.
Fixed end: node and inverted reflection. Free end: antinode in a standing mode and non-inverted reflection.
A este amplitudinea fiecărei unde progre: A is the amplitude of each travelling wave; resultant antinodes have amplitude 2A. The harmonic standing wave is already established.
